'''2014 Worlds Day 3 Aaron Kingery LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Day 3 is an OUT/IN change sheet on the Day 2 60 (2010 form, deck name Pimpin'). The numbered list below is that Day 2 sheet. OUT Fearlessness is not a line on the Day 2 60. Ditto marks expanded. (V) follows the sheet checkbox.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
